claimBoundary: The ijji.logo-sting.r3 family is an ijji-specific animated identity overlay; it is not a shared Landometer motif.
All other motifs remain framing rather than identity, data, evidence, score, confidence, completion, or product truth.
Landometer portfolio, methodology, and product-architecture language remains product-neutral across Land, Location, and Living.
Public availability is not an unrestricted third-party or open-source license.
Artifact release 1.2.1 does not retroactively modify the immutable design-system releases.
technicalConditions: Every delivered asset resolves path, MIME type, byte count, SHA-256, role, scope, and fallback in the manifest.
Exact source runtime and layer bytes must not be edited.
Audience parity is checked against the supplied example HTML at key timeline states and final frames.
Reduced motion and no-JavaScript routes show complete final-state fallbacks.
OWNER-MOTION-01 (2026-09-11, above the design system): every animation replays while it is inside the viewport and stops when it leaves; one page-level pause/resume control stays.
Repetition is produced by repeated finite plays, never by an infinite iteration count; family lifecycles still set the length of one cycle.
Portable snippets ship with the loop already set — the earlier 'inspection aid only' condition is withdrawn.
